entries.what: Labor Day off. Thao slept in after Saturday's shift, then set up a recurring $50 transfer to Linh in her banking app and asked the assistant how to label it so Hạnh wouldn't see it.
entries.outcome: Transfer set up under a neutral label, due on the 1st of each month.

entries.what: Holiday afternoon: Terrence texted the first union reminder flyer. Thao read it, left it unanswered and went for a walk on the Ulloa marsh boardwalk loop.
Evening at home in unit 207: packed rice for work, filled the thermos with cà phê sữa đá and put in earplugs against the noise from 209 next door.
Slept after the night shift, then at 3 p.m. had a card issue with the credit union and asked the assistant to draft a text asking to handle it by chat instead of calling.
entries.outcome: Text drafted and sent; the credit union agreed to chat.

entries.what: Tuesday afternoon grocery run at Ruiz Family Market for produce and fish sauce.

Evening: took the nurse shuttle up Ortega Hill from the gravel lot for her 7 p.m. shift on 4 West. She heard that Bao Tran had joined the IT desk at Ridgeline through a coworker mention, and was more focused on charting go-live gossip from Jasmine.
Home at 8 a.m. after the shift, slept from 8:30 with the blackout curtains and box fan. Hạnh's voicemail in Vietnamese came in at 1 p.m. and went unheard.
Requested Thanksgiving week off through the unit scheduler; the request was denied that afternoon.
entries.outcome: No holiday week; will look for a swap.

entries.what: Night shift on 4 West. Charting go-live talk filled the break room, and Thao ate her packed rice at 2 a.m.
Slept the day after the shift, then cleaned up a little and handled laundry with her card.
Off night. Terrence texted another flyer and Thao answered with a thumbs-up emoji only.
Evening: watched her baking show and fell asleep early with white noise on.
Friday off. Walked the marsh boardwalk in the morning, then did a quick call-free errand run for the week.
Heard the Egrets football opener crowd from the stadium as she drove past Vinca Avenue; she did not go.
entries.outcome: Home early to prep for Saturday's shift.

entries.what: Packed rice and filled the thermos, then slept in the late evening.
Afternoon at home, then the shuttle up Ortega Hill for the Saturday night shift. Linh messaged that Jun starts selling lumpia from the Heron & Grind counter today under Beatrice's 15% cut deal.
entries.outcome: Linh was happy for Jun; Thao was glad to hear her upbeat.

entries.what: Overnight shift on 4 West with Jasmine and Rubén. Steady census, no codes.
Early morning phở tái at Phở Bến Thành with Jasmine after the shift.
Slept until mid-afternoon with the curtains drawn and the fan on.
Sunday dinner at Hạnh's house on Pell Road; Hạnh asked about Linh's pharmacy plans and Thao steered the conversation to food.
entries.outcome: Dinner passed without a fight and Thao took home leftovers.

entries.what: Evening: Paolo reportedly missed another early prep session, which Linh mentioned about Jun's pop-up. Thao sorted her week's schedule and went to bed.
